status: Retrospective same-study split, specified before this implementation's fit; table values were already reviewed. Not a blind or independent-laboratory validation.
objective: Unweighted sum of squared natural-log permeability residuals; b is the only fitted parameter. No uncertainty weights are available.

split_rationale.calibration: AKP-30, one-hour holds, temperature series (1050/1100/1150 C)
split_rationale.primary_holdout: AKP-30, 1100 C, hold-time series (0/5/10 h). Same nominal powder and preparation family; never fitted.
split_rationale.transfer: AKP-15; different powder, reported processing aid; a diagnostic, not primary validation.
split_rationale.out_of_domain: CR-6 is dry pressed; AKP-50 is agglomerated. Show errors without using these rows to fit.

particle_size_scope: Approximate mean primary powder sizes from source methods. Not measured pore diameters, hydraulic radii or fitted effective sizes; uncertainties not given.

primary_screen.rule: Every primary held-out case must have |k_pred/k_measured - 1| <= 0.25.
primary_screen.basis: Project engineering screening choice specified before fitting, not a literature uncertainty bound, statistical test or user-prescribed tolerance. Report failure without tuning.

sensitivity: Leave one calibration row out and refit on the other two. Parameter range is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a confidence interval.

conditional_process_demo.scope: Illustrative flat, clean-water layers-in-series calculation with the existing Julia model. Operating conditions and selective resistances are assumptions. Within each measured/predicted comparison, the selective resistance is fixed using the MEASURED baseline k. Nominal 2 mm support thickness is used for both. Not measured full-membrane energy, a strength-feasible design recommendation, or a new OpenLB/DWSIM result.

unavailable: Permeability repeatability, replicate count and uncertainty
Actual individual pressure/flow series and water-test temperature/viscosity
Three-dimensional connected morphology tied to these specimens
